
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr><td class="t_f" id="postmessage_55023062">
<i class="pstatus"> 本帖最后由 Chehil 于 2026-3-27 00:51 编辑 </i><br>
<div class="parsedown-markdown"><p>最近在观看网课（学堂在线、中国大学 MOOC）时，被平台各种“霸王条款”折磨得心力交瘁：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>切屏/画中画秒暂停</strong>：哪怕是用分屏做笔记，页面失去焦点时，视频会自动暂停。</li>
<li><strong>锁死最高 2.0x 倍速</strong>：老师语速慢时简直煎熬，通过控制台强制修改底层 <code>playbackRate</code> 会被定时器重置。</li>
<li><strong>调整进度条疯狂卡死</strong>：一旦用脚本直接修改 <code>currentTime</code> 时，播放器极易抛出 <code>DOMException</code> 异常并锁死 UI。</li>
</ol>
<p>为了实现“左手 WSAD 盲操控制，右手安心做笔记”的沉浸式体验，我花了一些时间对这两个平台的前端机制进行了分析，并编写了对应的 Tampermonkey 优化脚本。在此记录一下解决思路，供大家参考。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="55023062_核心问题分析与解决思路">核心问题分析与解决思路</h3>
<h4 id="55023062_1.-突破切屏与画中画的自动暂停">1. 突破切屏与画中画的自动暂停</h4>
<p><strong>现象</strong>：切换标签页或使用浏览器原生画中画时，视频会自动触发暂停。此前尝试拦截底层 <code>HTMLVideoElement.prototype.pause</code> 或 jQuery 的 <code>trigger('pause')</code>，但这会导致播放器内部状态机错乱，引发网络请求节流相关的假死报错（<code>stalled</code> / <code>error.loader</code>）。</p>
<p><strong>解法</strong>：从源头屏蔽平台的失焦检测。通过拦截原生的 <code>addEventListener</code>，并在 <code>document-start</code> 阶段重写相关 DOM 属性，使网页代码无法感知页面状态的变化。</p>
<pre><code class="language-JavaScript">// 拦截现代事件监听与旧版 DOM 属性赋值
const blockEvents = ['visibilitychange', 'webkitvisibilitychange', 'blur', 'focusout', 'pagehide', 'mouseleave'];
// ... (拦截逻辑)
Object.defineProperties(document, {
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'hidden': { get: () =&gt; false, configurable: true },
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'visibilityState': { get: () =&gt; 'visible', configurable: true }
});</code></pre>
<h4 id="55023062_2.-绕过前端倍速轮询重置">2. 绕过前端倍速轮询重置</h4>
<p><strong>现象</strong>：平台前端存在定时器，会不断轮询底层的 <code>playbackRate</code>，若与 UI 菜单的值不符则强制重置。</p>
<p><strong>解法</strong>：通过 <code>Object.defineProperty</code> 劫持 <code>HTMLMediaElement.prototype.playbackRate</code> 的 <code>setter</code>。设置一个“锁定”状态，开启自定义倍速时，拦截并丢弃平台发出的重置指令。</p>
<h4 id="55023062_3.-解决脚本寻址导致的-domexception-卡死">3. 解决脚本寻址导致的 DOMException 卡死</h4>
<p><strong>现象</strong>：为了绑定自定义快进/后退快捷键，最初直接使用了 <code>video.currentTime += 5</code>。但由于平台使用的是 MSE (Media Source Extensions) 架构的播放器，直接修改时间会绕过其内部的缓冲管理器，导致状态机崩溃并抛出 <code>DOMException: aborted</code>。此外，由于 Webpack 的作用域隔离，外部脚本无法直接调用其内部封装的 jQuery API 发送合规指令。</p>
<p><strong>解法</strong>：放弃代码层面的 API 调用，转而通过计算进度条的 DOM 物理尺寸和目标时间的百分比，在特定的绝对坐标点生成并派发原生的 <code>MouseEvent</code>，以此触发播放器自带的缓冲逻辑。</p>
<h4 id="55023062_4.-兼容多平台与高频防抖-(debounce)">4. 兼容多平台与高频防抖 (Debounce)</h4>
<p><strong>现象</strong>：中国大学 MOOC 的进度条拖拽逻辑监听的是 <code>mousedown</code> 而非 <code>click</code>。同时，如果用户高频连续按键快进，会瞬间产生大量网络请求，再次导致 MSE 底层崩溃。</p>
<p><strong>解法</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>完善事件派发链路，依次触发 <code>mousedown</code> -&gt; <code>mouseup</code> -&gt; <code>click</code>，以兼容不同平台的监听方式。</li>
<li>引入 400ms 的防抖机制。连续按键期间只更新 OSD 视觉提示，停止按键 400ms 后才执行唯一一次坐标点击运算。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 id="55023062_最终代码实现">最终代码实现</h3>
<p>基于以上思路，最终整合了一版支持双平台的优化脚本。去除了所有具有侵入性的冲突拦截，保持了播放器原有的请求逻辑，稳定性较好。</p>
<p><strong>主要功能：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>稳定画中画</strong>：彻底屏蔽失焦检测，分屏/后台不暂停，正常记录时长。</li>
<li><strong>独立键位盲操 (WSAD)</strong>：分离平台原生方向键。
<ul>
<li><code>W</code> / <code>S</code>：控制音量。</li>
<li><code>A</code> / <code>D</code>：后退 / 快进 5 秒（带 400ms 防抖处理）。</li>
<li><code>C</code> / <code>X</code>：加速 / 减速（可突破 2.0x 限制）。</li>
<li><code>Z</code>：恢复 1.0x 原速并解除底层锁定。</li>
<li><code>Space</code>：原生底层播放/暂停。</li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>源代码：</strong></p>
<p>JavaScript</p>
<pre><code class="language-JavaScript">// ==UserScript==
// @name&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;网课播放优化
// @namespace&nbsp; &nbsp; http://tampermonkey.net/
// @version&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;14.9
// @description&nbsp;&nbsp;视频播放时用快捷键操控。
// @author&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; Chehil
// @match&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*://*.xuetangx.com/*
// @match&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*://*.icourse163.org/*
// @match&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*://*.bilibili.com/*
// @grant&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;none
// @run-at&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; document-start
// @license&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;MIT
// ==/UserScript==

(function() {
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'use strict';

&nbsp; &nbsp; // ==========================================
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 模块一：屏蔽失焦检测机制
&nbsp; &nbsp; // ==========================================
&nbsp; &nbsp; const blockEvents = ['visibilitychange', 'webkitvisibilitychange', 'blur', 'focusout', 'pagehide', 'mouseleave'];
&nbsp; &nbsp; const origAddEventListener = EventTarget.prototype.addEventListener;

&nbsp; &nbsp; EventTarget.prototype.addEventListener = function(type, listener, options) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (blockEvents.includes(type) &amp;&amp; (this === document || this === window)) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;return;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return origAddEventListener.apply(this, arguments);
&nbsp; &nbsp; };

&nbsp; &nbsp; const killSetter = (obj, prop) =&gt; {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;try {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;Object.defineProperty(obj, prop, { get: () =&gt; null, set: () =&gt; {}, configurable: true });
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;} catch (e) {}
&nbsp; &nbsp; };

&nbsp; &nbsp; killSetter(window, 'onblur');
&nbsp; &nbsp; killSetter(window, 'onpagehide');
&nbsp; &nbsp; killSetter(window, 'onfocusout');
&nbsp; &nbsp; killSetter(window, 'onmouseleave');
&nbsp; &nbsp; killSetter(document, 'onvisibilitychange');

&nbsp; &nbsp; Object.defineProperties(document, {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'hidden': { get: () =&gt; false, configurable: true },
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'visibilityState': { get: () =&gt; 'visible', configurable: true },
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'webkitHidden': { get: () =&gt; false, configurable: true },
&nbsp; &nbsp; });
&nbsp; &nbsp; Document.prototype.hasFocus = () =&gt; true;

&nbsp; &nbsp; // ==========================================
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 模块二：劫持媒体属性拦截平台重置
&nbsp; &nbsp; // ==========================================
&nbsp; &nbsp; const origPlaybackRate = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLMediaElement.prototype, 'playbackRate');
&nbsp; &nbsp; const origVolume = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLMediaElement.prototype, 'volume');

&nbsp; &nbsp; let isLocked = false;
&nbsp; &nbsp; let mySpeed = 1.0;
&nbsp; &nbsp; let myVolume = 1.0;

&nbsp; &nbsp; if (origPlaybackRate &amp;&amp; origPlaybackRate.set) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Object.defineProperty(HTMLMediaElement.prototype, 'playbackRate', {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;get: function() { return origPlaybackRate.get.call(this); },
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;set: function(val) { origPlaybackRate.set.call(this, isLocked ? mySpeed : val); }
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;});
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; if (origVolume &amp;&amp; origVolume.set) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Object.defineProperty(HTMLMediaElement.prototype, 'volume', {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;get: function() { return origVolume.get.call(this); },
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;set: function(val) { origVolume.set.call(this, isLocked ? myVolume : val); }
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;});
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; // ==========================================
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 模块三：UI反馈与事件防抖模拟
&nbsp; &nbsp; // ==========================================
&nbsp; &nbsp; window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () =&gt; {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const osd = document.createElement('div');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;osd.style.cssText = `
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;position: fixed;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;top: 12%;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;left: 50%;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;transform: translate(-50%, -8px);

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;min-width: max-content;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;max-width: min(80vw, 520px);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;padding: 10px 20px;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;border-radius: 999px;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;z-index: 2147483647;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;pointer-events: none;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;text-align: center;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;white-space: nowrap;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;overflow: hidden;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;text-overflow: ellipsis;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;opacity: 0;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;visibility: hidden;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;background:
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; linear-gradient(135deg,
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rgba(24, 26, 38, 0.72) 0%,
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rgba(32, 35, 52, 0.62) 100%
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; );

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%);

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;box-shadow:
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22),
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;font-size: 16px;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;font-weight: 500;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;line-height: 1.2;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;letter-spacing: 0.02em;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;font-family: "Segoe UI Symbol", Arial, sans-serif;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;font-variant-emoji: text;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;transition:
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; opacity 0.22s ease,
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; visibility 0.22s ease;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;document.body.appendChild(osd);

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;let osdTimer;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const showOSD = (text) =&gt; {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;osd.textContent = text;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;osd.style.visibility = 'visible';
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;osd.style.opacity = '1';
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;osd.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, 0)';

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;clearTimeout(osdTimer);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;osdTimer = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; osd.style.opacity = '0';
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; osd.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -8px)';
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; osd.style.visibility = 'hidden';
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}, 1500);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;};

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const formatTime = (seconds) =&gt; {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const s = Math.floor(seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;return `${m}:${s}`;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;};

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;let seekTargetTime = null;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;let seekTimer = null;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const activeTag = document.activeElement ? document.activeElement.tagName.toLowerCase() : '';
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (['input', 'textarea'].includes(activeTag) || document.activeElement.isContentEditable) return;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const video = document.querySelector('video');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (!video) return;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const hotkeys = ['Space', 'KeyA', 'KeyD', 'KeyW', 'KeyS', 'KeyX', 'KeyC', 'KeyZ'];
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (hotkeys.includes(e.code)) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; e.preventDefault();
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; e.stopImmediatePropagation();
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;switch (e.code) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; case 'Space': {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (video.paused) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;video.play().catch(()=&gt;{});
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;showOSD('▶ 播放');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;} else {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;video.pause();
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;showOSD('❚❚ 暂停');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; case 'KeyD': // D键：快进
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; case 'KeyA': { // A键：后退
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const delta = e.code === 'KeyD' ? 5 : -5;

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (seekTargetTime === null) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;seekTargetTime = video.currentTime;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;seekTargetTime = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(seekTargetTime + delta, video.duration - 0.1));
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;showOSD(delta &gt; 0 ? `快进至 ${formatTime(seekTargetTime)} 🡆` : `🡄 后退至 ${formatTime(seekTargetTime)}`);

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;clearTimeout(seekTimer);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;seekTimer = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;// 进度条模拟点击查找
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const progressBar = document.querySelector('.xt_video_player_progress') || // 学堂在线
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;document.querySelector('.progresswrap'); // 中国大学MOOC
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (progressBar) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; const rect = progressBar.getBoundingClientRect();
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; if (rect.width &gt; 0) {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const percentage = seekTargetTime / video.duration;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const targetX = rect.left + (rect.width * percentage);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const targetY = rect.top + (rect.height / 2);

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const dispatchMouse = (type) =&gt; {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;progressBar.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type, {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window,
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; clientX: targetX, clientY: targetY
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}));
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;};

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;dispatchMouse('mousedown');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;dispatchMouse('mouseup');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;dispatchMouse('click');
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; } else {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;video.currentTime = seekTargetTime;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;} else {
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; // 保底方案：如果没有找到进度条，直接走原生时间修改
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; video.currentTime = seekTargetTime;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;seekTargetTime = null;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}, 400);

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; case 'KeyW': // W键：音量加大
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;isLocked = true;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;myVolume = Math.min(video.volume + 0.1, 1);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;video.volume = myVolume;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;showOSD(`🔊 音量: ${Math.round(myVolume * 100)}%`);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; case 'KeyS': // S键：音量减小
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;isLocked = true;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;myVolume = Math.max(video.volume - 0.1, 0);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;video.volume = myVolume;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;showOSD(`🔉 音量: ${Math.round(myVolume * 100)}%`);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; case 'KeyC': // C键：加速
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;isLocked = true;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;mySpeed = Math.min(video.playbackRate + 0.25, 4.0);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;video.playbackRate = mySpeed;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;showOSD(`🚀 速度: ${mySpeed.toFixed(2)}x`);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; case 'KeyX': // X键：减速
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;isLocked = true;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;mySpeed = Math.max(video.playbackRate - 0.25, 0.25);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;video.playbackRate = mySpeed;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;showOSD(`🐢 速度: ${mySpeed.toFixed(2)}x`);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; case 'KeyZ': // Z键：恢复原速并解锁
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;isLocked = false;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;video.playbackRate = 1.0;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;showOSD(`🔘 恢复默认控制`);
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;break;
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}, true);
&nbsp; &nbsp; });

})();</code></pre>
<p><strong>提示：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>初次观看某些有服务端强制校验的课程时，建议谨慎使用过高倍速或拖拽功能，以免进度无效。复习时可正常使用。</li>
<li>代码供学习交流探讨，欢迎提出优化建议。</li>
</ul></div>
